主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. and Hillwood Development Company, LLC have entered into a definitive merger agreement to acquire Verde Realty. The transaction will provide Verde shareholders with a price of $12.85 per share and a total equity transaction value of up to $366 million. BROOKFIELD ASSET MANAGEMENT INC. and certain shareholders of Verde, comprising approximately 19% of the outstanding shares, have entered into definitive voting agreements to support the merger. At closing, a subsidiary of the Fund will merge into Verde Realty, with Verde as the surviving entity. Hillwood will be an investor in Verde. All existing shareholders will receive cash, with accredited investors having the option to receive common shares instead, subject to a shareholders’ agreement and a requirement that the Fund acquires at least 55% of Verde on a fully diluted basis. The merger is subject to shareholder approval and expected to close in Q4 2012. Wells Fargo Securities provided a fairness opinion. Brookfield's merger is expected to position Verde to benefit from increased industrial space demand as the economy improves. The Fund agreed to provide up to $200 million in capital for rights offerings.
